title.en: The Two Orders at the Passes

desc.zh: 登记山道上确实相冲突的义务：大顺边务衙门的征役与缅京旧例的贡期各是一份命令。提案国逐项核对、向两边分别求得回书，单一合法安排时不虚构两属。
desc.en: Register the obligations that genuinely clash at the passes: the frontier office's levy and the old Burmese tribute season are two separate orders. The proposing hill country verifies each one, asks both courts for their replies in writing, and never invents a double allegiance when only one arrangement is lawful.

title.en: The Mandate of the Local Council

desc.zh: 回书到齐之后进入执行：贡茶折费、有限粮供或按村分摊，每一家承担自己的真实成本；联席会议由实际受牵连的地方国共议，谁有权代表、谁被落下，都要写进册子。
desc.en: With the replies in, execution begins: tea tribute converted to a fee, a limited grain supply, or village-by-village apportionment, each bearing its own real cost. The joint council convenes among the hill countries actually affected; who may speak for it and who is left out must be written into the register.

title.en: New Bounds for the Frontier Precedent

desc.zh: 执行与复议阶段检验旧例的边界：过境兵的冬粮、一枚印信能否两签、贸易与军事条款的分合，最后按各方实际落款与实付回写贡期之后的山路。
desc.en: Execution and review test where the old precedent ends: the transit troops' winter grain, whether one seal can sign twice, the split between trade and military clauses, and finally the mountain roads after tribute season are written back according to each party's actual signature and actual payment.

title.zh: 先到的是贡期还是军令
title.en: Tribute Season or the Military Order

desc.zh: 山道上同时到了两份文书：大顺边务衙门催征冬役，缅京使者重提旧例贡期。提案国逐项核对两份义务是否确实相冲突；只有一方提出要求时，登记为单一合法安排，不虚构两属。
desc.en: Two documents arrive on the same pass road: the Great Shun frontier office pressing the winter levy, and the Burmese envoy reviving the old tribute season. The proposing hill country checks clause by clause whether the two obligations genuinely clash; when only one court demands anything, it is registered as a single lawful arrangement and no double allegiance is invented.

title.en: No Official Road to the Villages

desc.zh: 征役的文书有了，路还没有：可征的人口散在茶山与河谷之间，官道只到土司衙门。核查可征役人口、道路与实际维护成本之后，再把两份命令正式送出去求答。
desc.en: The levy papers exist; the road does not. The corvee-liable households are scattered between the tea hills and the river valleys, and the official road stops at the chieftain's gate. Only after checking the levy-liable population, the roads and the real cost of upkeep are the two orders formally sent out for replies.

title.en: Who Speaks for the Joint Council

desc.zh: 联席议事开到一半就停了：土司们各带各村的名册，却没人说得出自己能代表谁。核对地方授权与反对者之后，或以有限共议入约，或交由集中裁决而留下后续争执。
desc.en: The joint council stalls halfway: the chieftains each bring their villages' registers, yet none can say whom they are empowered to speak for. title.en: Three Signatures on the Frontier Compact

desc.zh: 会约文本誊清，落款分三种：实付与更正俱全者签完整会约；只入局部互市者签有限会约；不愿落款者保留现状。落款只对本方生效，谁签了什么、限到哪一条，各册各自记清。
desc.en: The compact text is copied out fair, and the signatures come in three forms: those whose payment and correction are both complete sign the full compact; those joining only the border trade sign the limited one; those unwilling to sign keep the status quo. A signature binds only its own signatory; what each signed and where each clause stops is recorded plainly in each own ledger.

title.en: The Mountain Roads after Tribute Season

desc.zh: 会约落款之后一个整年，山路按册检验：征役是否按期限止住，贡茶折费是否实付，边务衙门的巡防开销是否有着落。SHU 签字国从本国国库实付边费；守约者留名，失约者如实记败，回写地方治理与下一轮代表权。
desc.en: A full year after the signatures, the mountain roads are checked against the register: did the levies stop on their term, was the tea fee actually paid, and does the frontier office's patrol spending have its funding? SHU signatories pay the frontier upkeep from their own treasury; those who kept faith keep their standing, defaults are recorded as failures, and the verdict is written back to local governance and to the next round of representation.
